title: How Opening the Bill the Day It Arrives Trains a Godly Man's Self-Control
caption:
You know exactly what's in the envelope. That's why it's still sealed.

A godly man doesn't negotiate with the parts of his life that scare him. He shows up to them on schedule, mail included.

Opening the bill the day it lands isn't about the bill. It's the same muscle you'll need for the harder thing next week.

Start with what's on your desk today.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #discipline #selfcontrol
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
